question: The first modern Olympic Games under IOC was held in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1896**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first modern Olympic Games(Summer Olympics) under International Olympic Games(IOC) were held in Athens, Greece in the year 1896.
 
• It was officially known as the **Games of the Olympiad**, and commonly known as '__**Athens 1896**'.
 
• Organized by the International Olympic Committee(IOC) which was created by **French Pierre de Coubertin**.
 
• There were 9 sporting events featured in the Summer Olympics in 1896.
 
• Fourteen nations and 241 athletes all males took part.
 
• Silver medals were awarded to the winners, Copper medals to the runner-ups and no medals were awarded to the 3rd position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The Headquarters of the International Olympic Committee is in **Lausanne, Switzerland**.
 
• The President of the International Olympic Committee is **Thomas Bach**. 
 
• **Demetrius Vikelas **the 1st President of the Olympic Games.
 
• The next Olympic **2024 **will be held in** Paris, France**.
